name: Hall
desc: A big, smooth stereo hall that keeps its low end apart from its shimmer. Long decays for ambient washes.

name: Plate
desc: The classic studio plate: dense, bright and quick to bloom. Lovely on vocals, snares and keys.

name: Cloud
desc: Grains of what you play, scattered in time and pitch and fed back into themselves. Set Pitch to 0 / +12 for shimmering clouds.

name: Tape Echo
desc: Repeats that darken, saturate and wobble like worn tape, bouncing left and right. Push Feedback past 100% for runaway echoes.

name: Ensemble
desc: The three-voice string-machine ensemble: slow swirl plus fast shimmer, the sound of a Solina and Vangelis-era pads.

name: Juno Chorus
desc: The Juno-60's bucket-brigade chorus: I, II, or both at once for the fast, shimmering vibrato.

name: Tape
desc: A tape machine: soft saturation, a low-end bump, rolled-off highs, wow and flutter and a little hiss. Age takes it from fresh to worn.

name: Lo-Fi
desc: Fewer bits, a lower sample rate, a worn-record wobble, crackle and a dark filter.

name: Ladder Filter
desc: A Moog-style ladder filter with an LFO and an envelope follower: slow sweeps, swells, or wah when you play harder.

name: Bus Compressor
desc: Glue for the whole mix. Lower Mix for parallel (New York) compression: punch without losing the transients.

name: Auto-Pan
desc: Tremolo (Pan at 0) or auto-pan (Pan at 100): smooth or choppy.

name: Ring Mod
desc: A ring modulator for bells, metallic shimmer and alien drones, with a slow drift on the carrier.

name: Marimba
desc: Wooden bars and tube resonators struck with a mallet. Hard mallets bring out the attack; soft ones the tone.

name: Nylon Guitar
desc: A classical guitar string and body. Pluck near the bridge for bite, toward the middle for warmth.

name: Violin
desc: A bowed string: bow pressure and position, slow or sharp attacks, and vibrato that grows as the note sustains.

name: Flute
desc: Breath, embouchure and vibrato: breathy and soft or bright and pure.

name: Clarinet
desc: Reed stiffness and bell opening shape a woody, hollow tone.

name: Voice
desc: A singing voice, bass to soprano, with vowels you can glide between: choirs and vocal pads.
